_comment: Single source of truth for the six Override patterns. Edit here, then run build_patterns.py. That script regenerates /pattern/<slug>/index.html for each entry AND rewrites the PATTERNS block inside assessment.html between its marker comments, so the quiz and the pages can never drift apart.
_loop: Each pattern's `loop` is the Override Method drawn out for that specific person. trigger -> story -> pattern is the closed loop they're already running. pause -> override -> action is the way out. Keep these short enough to read as diagram labels, not paragraphs.

achiever.name: The Achiever
achiever.reframe: Your pattern isn't laziness or lack of drive. It's the opposite. You've learned to tie your worth to your output. Somewhere along the way, achievement became the way you stay safe, valued, and respected.
gives: Discipline most people wish they had
Drive that actually gets things done
Reliability people know they can count on
costs: Relationships get pushed to the back burner
Success never quite feels like enough

loop.story: “If I stop now, I lose the edge.”
loop.pattern: You start the next thing before you've felt this one.
loop.pause: Notice the itch to start again.
loop.override: Your worth was never the output.
loop.action: Sit in the win for one full day before you take the next thing.

achiever.seoDescription: You tie your worth to your output. Here's what the Achiever pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.

fixer.name: The Fixer
fixer.belief: “If I don't hold it together, no one will.”
fixer.reframe: Your pattern isn't weakness or people-pleasing. It's care turned all the way up. You learned that being needed is how you stay connected and safe, so you became the one who handles everything for everyone.
gives: A big heart people feel instantly
The ability to hold things together under pressure
costs: Your own needs always land last
Quiet resentment you never say out loud
Exhaustion from carrying what isn't yours
override: Letting people carry their own weight

loop.story: “If I don't step in, this falls apart.”
loop.pattern: You pick up their weight and put your own thing down.
loop.pause: Catch yourself reaching for what isn't yours.
loop.override: Being needed is not the same as being loved.
loop.action: Ask what they actually want before you hand them a solution.

fixer.seoDescription: You're the one who holds it together for everyone. Here's what the Fixer pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.

peacekeeper.name: The Peacekeeper
peacekeeper.belief: “If I keep everyone comfortable, I'll be okay.”
peacekeeper.reframe: Your pattern isn't weakness. It's a finely-tuned radar for everyone else's comfort. You learned that smoothing things over keeps you safe, so you got good at going along, even when it quietly costs you.
gives: People feel calm and easy around you
You read a room better than anyone
You rarely make a situation worse
costs: Resentment builds where no one can see it
You slowly disappear from your own life
override: Your voice over the room's comfort
The real thing over the easy thing

loop.trigger: The room tightens. Someone is upset.
loop.story: “If I say the real thing, this gets worse.”
loop.pattern: You smooth it over and swallow your take.
loop.pause: Feel the sentence you are about to not say.
loop.override: Their comfort is not your job.
loop.action: Say the real thing once, in a calm voice, and let it land.

peacekeeper.seoDescription: You keep everyone comfortable, even when it costs you. Here's what the Peacekeeper pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.

perfectionist.name: The Perfectionist
perfectionist.belief: “If it's not perfect, it's not ready.”
perfectionist.reframe: Your pattern isn't procrastination. It's protection. High standards started as your edge, but quietly became a place to hide. As long as it isn't finished, it can't be judged.
gives: An eye for what everyone else misses
costs: You're rarely satisfied, even with good work

loop.trigger: The work is good enough to send.
loop.story: “If it's not right, it's not ready.”
loop.pattern: You go back in and polish it one more time.
loop.action: Send it at eighty-five percent and let the world respond.

perfectionist.seoDescription: If it's not perfect, it's not ready. Here's what the Perfectionist pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.

controller.name: The Controller
controller.belief: “If I don't stay on top of it, things start slipping.”
controller.reframe: Your pattern isn't being a control freak. It's how you've learned to feel safe in a world that's felt unpredictable. Managing every variable is how you keep the floor from dropping out.
gives: You make things happen others can't
People feel safe in your hands
Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch
costs: Chronic tension you can't switch off
override: Loosening the grip and staying okay

loop.story: “If I'm not on top of it, it slips.”
loop.pattern: You take it back and run it yourself.
loop.override: Uncertainty is not the same as danger.
loop.action: Hand one thing over and let them do it their way.

controller.seoDescription: If you don't stay on top of it, things start slipping. Here's what the Controller pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.

avoider.name: The Avoider
avoider.reframe: Your pattern isn't laziness. It's self-protection. Somewhere you learned that staying uncommitted keeps you safe from failing, so “later” became the place you put the things that matter most.
gives: You see options other people rush right past
costs: The things that matter keep waiting
A low hum of stuck you can't quite name

loop.trigger: The thing that matters comes up again.
loop.pattern: You find something smaller and busy yourself with it.
loop.pause: Catch the swerve as it happens.
loop.override: Later is a decision, not a delay.
loop.action: Do the first ten minutes of it right now, badly.

avoider.seoDescription: You'll deal with it later. Here's what the Avoider pattern gives you, what it quietly costs you, and the first move to override it.
